inlines.v: ATTOL'LENT, adjective [Latin attollens, attollo, of ad and tollor, to lift.] Lifting up; raising; as an attollent muscle. ATTOL'LENT, noun a muscle which raises some part, as the ear, the tip of the nose, or the upper eye lid; otherwise called levator and elevator.
